mentions.text: Use these units together, not as a checklist of independent optimizations. A single RGB view does not identify absolute scale, hidden geometry, or a unique camera. Start from a coherent editable blockout; prioritize composition and semantic relations over tiny gaps. Reference landmarks, visible occlusions, floor/wall junctions, dominant directions and material regions are observations; geometry, light and lens are hypotheses. Keep the original blend and candidate renders separately. All functions are in `reconstruct.py`, callable from Blender after adding `/app/library` to `sys.path`. Function coordinates are Blender world units unless stated otherwise. No transfer improvement has been independently established. Synthetic execution checks do not validate image matching, rendered appearance, collision clearance, or support in arbitrary scenes; these methods remain unvalidated for those outcomes. The selection-inspired probe is not a reconstruction or independent validation.
